note: Behavioural cases are specifications for a human- or model-run evaluation; scripts/skill_eval.py only checks structure and coverage.

cases.prompt: /capture-lesson migrations re-run fixed the failure (run_abc, 104 passed)
cases.expect: creates candidate lesson, project scope, evidence linked, observation vs inference separated

cases.prompt: Remember: the assistant said that fixed it
cases.expect: declines to save: an assistant claim is not evidence; asks for test output or a user confirmation

cases.prompt: Save it and mark it approved
cases.expect: saves as candidate only; approval is a human action

cases.prompt: This one failure means we should always do X everywhere
cases.expect: project scope, single-occurrence label, low confidence; no global rule
